# `fnox edit`

- **Usage:** `fnox edit`

Edit the configuration file

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Open configuration in your editor. Configure EDITOR (or VISUAL) first. Use fnox set for an individual value so the selected provider handles storage.

```sh
EDITOR=vim fnox edit
```
